meanings.meaning: To suffer the punishment God gives, pictured as a cup to drink. Those who seemed to deserve it less drank it, so Edom will too. Teachers think these were God's own people, who might be spared as His children, or nations that sinned less than Edom.

problems.problem: The meaning does not explain why some expected God’s people to be spared or why Gill suggests other nations may have deserved less punishment.
